mutations.because: Revert the accent solid band back to reading the CREATIVE_GEOMETRY constant directly: a template that sets accent.solidHeight to paint a taller band gets the same band it would with no prop at all — R-D3's promise (each drawer reads ONE merged value) broken exactly at the accent layer.
command: a taller solid band covers more rows in the brand colour

mutations.because: Revert the accent fade band back to the constant: a template that sets accent.fadeHeight to extend the fade's footprint upward gets the pre-merge footprint instead — the fade prop stops moving any pixel.
command: a taller fade extends the band's footprint upward

mutations.because: Revert the logo's target width back to the constant: a template that sets logo.width to paint a wider logo gets the default span instead — the width prop stops widening the drawn footprint.
command: a larger width paints the logo over a wider span

mutations.because: Revert the logo's edge margin back to the constant: a template that sets logo.margin to pull the corner logo inward keeps the default margin instead — the corner never moves.
command: a larger margin pulls the corner logo inward

mutations.because: Revert the autofit floor back to reading the constant directly at the fitText call site: a text layer's typeFloor prop no longer moves where the autofit loop stops, so a higher floor no longer keeps the headline larger.
command: a higher floor keeps the headline larger
